Skilled in Version Control Tools (Git, Subversion), Technical Support, IntelliJ, Visual Studio, Java, C#, VB.net, Angular, Linux, Agile Methodologies, SQL, Salesforce and Atlassian tools. Strong engineering background with a Bachelor's degree focused in Mathematics and Engineering from Bradley University.
